issues.explanation: The ending says Wu Guotai’s reminder “引得周瑜立下抗曹战功,” which implies Zhou Yu has already performed the anti-Cao campaign. At this point, the source only foreshadows Zhou Yu’s later role.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the ending to indicate that Sun Quan’s recollection sets the stage for Zhou Yu’s later anti-Cao campaign, without presenting that campaign as already completed.
